en.headline: Customs arrests Mong Kok jersey shop owner over delayed deliveries and refunds
en.dek: A 50-year-old man was arrested on Wednesday after 38 customers reported paying for jerseys, printing and badges that were not supplied on time, involving about HK$67,000.
body: Hong Kong Customs arrested a 50-year-old man on Wednesday who is the person in charge of a sportswear shop in Mong Kok. The arrest followed complaints that the shop accepted payments for jerseys, jersey printing and badges but failed to deliver the ordered goods by the promised date or within a reasonable time, and did not arrange timely refunds.

As of Tuesday, Customs had received reports from 38 customers, with the total amount involved amounting to about HK$67,000. The shop operated both online and from a physical premises in Mong Kok. The arrested man has been released on bail pending further inquiries, and the case remains under investigation.

Customs said a trader who accepts payment with the intention of not supplying the product, or of supplying a materially different product, or who has no reasonable grounds to believe it can be supplied within the specified or a reasonable time, commits an offence under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance. Upon conviction, the maximum penalty is a fine of HK$500,000 and up to five years in prison.

The department reminded traders to comply with the ordinance and urged consumers to buy from reputable merchants. Members of the public can report suspected violations by calling the Customs 24-hour hotline on 182 8080.

zh.headline: 旺角球衣店收錢不交貨不退款 海關拘捕50歲負責人
zh.dek: 海關周三拘捕旺角一間球衣店50歲男負責人，截至周二接獲38名顧客投訴，涉及約6.7萬元，指付款後未能按時交貨或退款。
body: 香港海關周三拘捕一名50歲男子，他是旺角一間球衣店的負責人。海關早前接獲多宗舉報，指該店在網上及實體店舖銷售球衣、球衣印字及徽章時，接受顧客付款預訂後，未能於指定日期或合理時間內供應貨品，亦未有適時安排退款。
截至周二，海關接獲的舉報涉及38名顧客，款項共約6.7萬元。涉事店舖位於旺角，兼營網上及實體業務。被捕男子現已獲准保釋候查，案件仍在調查中。
海關表示，根據《商品說明條例》，商戶在接受付款時，意圖不供應有關產品、意圖供應與訂購產品有重大分別的產品，或沒有合理理由相信能在指定或合理時間內供應產品，即屬違法。一經定罪，最高可被判罰款50萬元及監禁5年。
海關提醒商戶遵守條例規定，並呼籲消費者光顧信譽良好的商戶。市民如懷疑有違反條例的情況，可致電海關24小時熱線182 8080舉報。
